items.name: dsh-cursor-theme
items.summary: Per-state mouse cursor customization for DeepSeek Harness: 14 UI states, 18 original preset themes, ZIP image pack import/export, and one-click system-level apply.
items.description: Customize the PC mouse cursor for every UI state inside DeepSeek Harness (default, pointer, text, wait, not-allowed, grab, grabbing, progress, cell, copy, move, resize and more). Ships 18 original preset themes covering all 14 states, a per-state SVG template library, PNG/CUR upload, ZIP image pack import/export, hotspot editing, and one-click system-level cursor application on Windows (registry + SPI_SETCURSORS) with an experimental macOS overlay.
